desc: Write complete program: sieve primes up to 31623 for trial division.
Implement deterministic Miller–Rabin is_prime valid for < 2^64 (bases [2, 325, 9375, 28178, 450775, 9780504, 1795265022]).
Implement factor_distinct(n) with caching dict for repeated N values.
Per test case: N==1 → output "2 1"; else scan k=1,2,... for prime p=kN+1.
Factor p−1 = kN (union of factors of k and N), find primitive root g by testing pow(g, (p−1)//q, p) != 1 for all q.
Compute A = pow(g, (p−1)//N, p), M = p; sanity-verify pow(A, N, p) == 1 and pow(A, N//q, p) != 1 for q | N.
Fast I/O with sys.stdin.buffer, collect outputs, print; mentally verify samples (N=3 → 2 7; N=16 → 3 17).
Final verification pass: trace samples and edge cases (N=1, N=2, N=10^9, repeated N cache hits), confirm output bounds and correctness of order argument.
